_about: Motion for the traced Home-card art. The traced shapes have no names, so parts are picked by path number (drawing order, counting from 0, after the hidden raster). pathCount guards against a re-export, which renumbers everything. groups: which paths move together and how (anim/delay/duration/repeat/rotate/translate as in ../motion.json; origin is a pivot [x, y] on the 300x400 card, or bottom/top/left/top-left/center of the group). inserts: extra art drawn after path `after`; with `clip` it is clipped to those paths (patches that fill the hole a moving part leaves); with `group` it moves with that group. drop: paths removed. See scripts/import-traced-art.mjs.
